description: In an era where artificial intelligence dominates headlines about the future of work and learning, Tom Lauwers presents a different perspective in this MAGICademy episode: educational technology focused on amplifying rather than replacing human creativity through robotics. As founder and CTO of BirdBrain Technologies, Lauwers has spent over two decades developing robotics tools that serve as a creative medium, turning seventh graders into poetry performers through animatronic displays and art te…
classificationReason: The episode centers on using robotics as a creative and educational medium, featuring BirdBrain Technologies founder Tom Lauwers and classroom applications.
qualityReason: Transcript provides practitioner background, concrete robotics kits and classroom examples, and some sustained discussion, but the treatment is largely aspirational and conversational rather than critically analytical.
